patch.value: GH-910: keep extension assets outside item merge-driver patterns

GitHub #910 reports that pm merge install applies item-aware Markdown and TOON merge drivers to .agents/pm/extensions package assets. Generate item-only patterns or explicit exclusions and verify custom roots, attributes, idempotency, audit, and refresh behavior.
Extension documentation and metadata never resolve to item merge drivers; registered item files retain field-aware drivers; default and custom tracker roots pass git check-attr and fence audit tests.
